answer.rationale: Rollback is unavailable: the in-window release is a must-keep security patch, so memory_b1 is not actionable. Circuit breaking (b4) would fail writes at settlement peak and violates the no-lost-writes objective. Regional failover (b2) is a heavier disruption while writes are already heavy and is not clearly indicated as a regional fault. Read-replica routing (b5) previously helped when report/dashboard reads sat on the primary; the live symptom is write-path p99 under peak settlement writes, so that playbook is a weaker match. memory_b3 is the closest prior: extra headroom kept queues flat through a write surge. Cause is still mixed (release timing vs. peak load), so I am verifying b3 before committing and treating add_capacity as the single write-preserving availability move.
